title: Tell HMRC you have completed a National Minimum Wage review
text:
If HMRC has written to your business asking you to review whether you’re paying your workers the correct National Minimum Wage, complete this declaration to confirm you’ve completed your review.

 If you’ve found errors, HMRC will not charge you a penalty or publicly name your business.

 If you do not complete the declaration and HMRC later receives information that your workers may be underpaid, you may have to pay a penalty. Your business may be publicly named by the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade.

 Who can use this declaration

 You can only complete this declaration if you are an authorised person. In most cases this will be:

 • a company director

 • a company secretary

 • a partner

 • a trustee

 • an agent acting on behalf of and authorised by the company

 What you need

 You’ll need:

 • your PAYE reference number

 • the 3-letter code at the top of your letter, if you received one

 If you’ve found any underpayments, you’ll also need to tell us the:

 • number of workers affected

 • amount owed to workers

 • reasons for the underpayment

 Tell HMRC you have completed your review

 You’ll need to sign in to use this service. If you do not already have sign in details, you’ll be able to create them. 

 Start now 

 You can save your progress and come back later.

 After you submit the declaration

 HMRC will review the declaration and contact you if any more information is needed.

 You do not need to contact HMRC to confirm that you have submitted the declaration.
